# Telemetry fields

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/generate-telemetry-fields.mjs` from `packages/shared/src/telemetry-vocabulary.ts`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Volli's own telemetry will have two parts, each with its own switch: usage statistics and
crash reports. No build sends either yet. The exporter, its identifiers and its consent
controls ship separately, and are held to this page.

## Where Volli asks first

In these regions, and wherever the region is unknown, Volli will send nothing until you
choose. Elsewhere it will send once it has shown a first-run notice saying how to turn it
off. Regions are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes:

`AT`, `BE`, `BG`, `CY`, `CZ`, `DE`, `DK`, `EE`, `ES`, `FI`, `FR`, `GR`, `HR`, `HU`, `IE`, `IT`, `LT`, `LU`, `LV`, `MT`, `NL`, `PL`, `PT`, `RO`, `SE`, `SI`, `SK`, `AX`, `GF`, `GP`, `MF`, `MQ`, `RE`, `YT`, `IS`, `LI`, `NO`, `GB`, `CA`

## Usage statistics

Every usage event Volli's own telemetry service may receive is listed below, with every
property it may carry. A property that is not listed is never part of a usage event.
The identifier and timestamp each event is sent with will be described here when the
exporter ships.

No property can hold free text. Each one is:

- a word from a fixed list
- a count
- an integer, such as an exit code
- a duration
- a fraction, such as a sampling rate
- true or false
- a release version, or `unknown`
- a provider or model id from the model catalog Volli ships, or `custom`
- a count for each word of a fixed list
- a list of rows made of the above, at most 256 long

In particular, Volli never sends:

- ticket, project, workspace or repository names
- file paths, commands, prompts, model output or tool arguments
- error messages
- email addresses, account ids or host names
- the names of providers or models you configured yourself (these are sent as `custom`)

This list is separate from the collector you can configure in Settings → System →
Telemetry, which receives the Agent Runtime's own events and is controlled there.

### `app_started`

Once per launch, when the first window has shown.

| Property | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cold_start_ms` | Duration in milliseconds | Process start to first window shown. |
| `launch` | One of: `first-run`, `update`, `normal` | First launch of this install, first launch of a new version, or neither. |
| `app_version` | A release version such as `0.3.0`, or `unknown` | The running build's version. |
| `channel` | One of: `release`, `canary` | The build's release channel. |
| `os` | One of: `darwin`, `linux`, `win32` | Operating system. |
| `os_version_major` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | Operating system major version. |
| `arch` | One of: `arm64`, `x64`, `other` | CPU architecture. |
| `os_region` (optional) | An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (249 values) | The country the operating system's region setting names. Absent when it names none. |
| `signed_in` | true or false | Whether a Volli account is signed in. |

### `renderer_gone`

A window's renderer process ended unexpectedly.

| Property | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reason` | One of: `clean-exit`, `abnormal-exit`, `killed`, `crashed`, `oom`, `launch-failed`, `integrity-failure`, `memory-eviction`, `unknown` | Electron's reason. |
| `exit_code` | Integer | The process exit code. |

### `feature_used`

A person used a product feature. Says which feature, never what it was used on.

| Property | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feature` | One of: `board-create-ticket`, `board-move-ticket`, `ticket-open`, `session-start`, `session-resume`, `composer-send`, `composer-attach`, `model-switch`, `terminal-open`, `browser-open`, `file-open`, `change-set-open`, `worktree-archive`, `automation-arm`, `automation-run`, `runner-link`, `workspace-switch`, `workspace-invite`, `project-create`, `project-add-existing`, `provider-sign-in`, `mcp-server-add`, `attention-open`, `command-palette-open`, `settings-open`, `canvas-edit` | The feature. |

### `agent_rollup`

One per Session per hour of agent activity: the Agent Runtime's events, summed on the device.

| Property | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `window_ms` | Duration in milliseconds | How long the summed period was. |
| `models` | A list of at most 256 rows, each with the fields below | One row per provider and model used. |
| `models[].gen_ai.provider.name` | A provider id from the model catalog Volli ships, or `custom` | The provider. |
| `models[].gen_ai.request.model` | A model id the model catalog Volli ships lists under `gen_ai.provider.name`, or `custom` | The model requested. |
| `models[].attempts` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | Provider requests made. |
| `models[].stop_reasons` | A count for each of: `stop`, `length`, `toolUse`, `error`, `aborted`, `deferred`, `unknown`. A word that counted nothing may be left out | Requests by how they ended. |
| `models[].provider_error_classes` | A count for each of: `auth`, `rate-limit`, `overloaded`, `timeout`, `transport`, `invalid-request`, `unknown`. A word that counted nothing may be left out | Failed requests by error class. |
| `models[].gen_ai.usage.input_tokens` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | Uncached input tokens, summed. |
| `models[].gen_ai.usage.output_tokens` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | Output tokens, summed. |
| `models[].gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | Input tokens served from the provider's cache, summed. |
| `models[].gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | Input tokens written to the provider's cache, summed. |
| `models[].gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | Reasoning tokens, summed. |
| `tools` | A list of at most 256 rows, each with the fields below | One row per tool, capability class and the model that called the tool. |
| `tools[].gen_ai.provider.name` | A provider id from the model catalog Volli ships, or `custom` | The provider. |
| `tools[].gen_ai.request.model` | A model id the model catalog Volli ships lists under `gen_ai.provider.name`, or `custom` | The model requested. |
| `tools[].gen_ai.tool.name` (optional) | One of: `read`, `edit`, `write`, `bash`, `ask_user`, `web_fetch`, `web_search`, `browser_tabs`, `browser_navigate`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_act`, `browser_screenshot`, `browser_console`, `browser_acquire`, `browser_release`, `todo_write`, `shell_start`, `shell_output`, `shell_kill`, `browser_find`, `classify`, `codemode`, `request_secret` | The tool, when it is one Volli ships. Absent for any other tool. |
| `tools[].activity_kind` | One of: `run-command`, `read-file`, `edit-file`, `write-file`, `search`, `list-directory`, `fetch-url`, `plan`, `delegate`, `browse`, `other` | What kind of work the tool call did. |
| `tools[].completed` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | Calls that completed. |
| `tools[].failed` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | Calls that failed. |
| `turns` | A count for each of: `completed`, `interrupted`. A word that counted nothing may be left out | Turns by how they ended. |
| `compactions` | A list of at most 256 rows, each with the fields below | One row per compaction reason and outcome. |
| `compactions[].reason` | One of: `threshold`, `overflow`, `manual`, `checkpoint` | Why compaction ran. |
| `compactions[].outcome` | One of: `compacted`, `failed` | How it ended. |
| `compactions[].count` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | How many times. |
| `attachment_failures` | A count for each of: `auth`, `configuration`, `context`, `reasoning`, `model`, `aborted`, `unknown`. A word that counted nothing may be left out | Agent Runtime attachments that failed, by reason. |
| `attention_raised` | A count for each of: `auth`, `configuration`, `context`, `runtime-failure`, `partial-turn`, `transport`. A word that counted nothing may be left out | Times a Session asked for attention, by reason. |
| `dropped` | A count for each of: `queue-full`, `sink-error`, `scrubber-error`, `expired`. A word that counted nothing may be left out | Telemetry events lost before sending, by reason. |

### `turn_sampled`

A random sample of finished turns, for latency percentiles.

| Property | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `duration_ms` | Duration in milliseconds | Turn opened to turn ended. |
| `queued_ms` (optional) | Duration in milliseconds | Message received to turn opened, when measured. |
| `ttft_ms` (optional) | Duration in milliseconds | First request to its first streamed event, when one arrived. |
| `attempts` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | Provider requests in the turn. |
| `tool_calls` | Count (integer, 0 or more) | Tool calls in the turn. |
| `outcome` | One of: `completed`, `interrupted` | How the turn ended. |
| `sample_rate` | Fraction, above 0 and at most 1 | The fraction of turns sampled. |

### `runner_heartbeat_daily`

Once a day per signed-in Runner.

| Property | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `runner_kind` | One of: `mac`, `linux`, `cloud` | Where the Runner runs. |
| `runner_version` | A release version such as `0.3.0`, or `unknown` | The Runner's version. |

## Crash reports

Not sent yet. Crash reports will keep an error's stack trace but never its message. When
the error is one of Volli's own typed errors with one of these codes, the report carries
the code instead:

- `client-capability-unavailable`
- `credential-key-pending`
- `credential-lock-busy`
- `credential-lock-unusable`
- `credential-revision-conflict`
- `invalid_id`
- `invalid_key_part`
- `invalid_position`
- `malformed_actor`
- `sealed-file-changed`
- `sealed-file-indeterminate`
- `sealed-file-unverified`
- `secret-key-unavailable`
- `trash-unavailable`
